name: IntegrateIT Enhanced Scheduler
notes: A headless time-of-day + day-of-week scheduler for Control4 with up to six independent slots, each with its own time, weekday mask, and enable switch. Every slot fires a generic Schedule Fired event (and, for slots 1-3, a dedicated per-slot event) so Composer programming keys off flexible recurring schedules the built-in scheduler cannot express. Manual test-fire, next-fire preview, MAC-locked IntegrateIT licensing.
